channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Meta settles social media addiction case with California, other states for $16.7 billion
item.description: Meta and state attorneys general settled a federal trial centering on allegations that company misrepresented the extent of child-related mental health harms.

item.title: Nvidia earnings live updates: Q2 results, memory prices and AI outlook
item.description: Follow Nvidia’s Q2 2027 earnings for data center results, guidance, AI demand and NVDA stock reaction in real time.

item.title: Bill Gates warns ‘there is no plan’ for the ‘upheaval’ AI will cause
item.description: Bill Gates warned governments are not adequately preparing for how AI could displace workers, strain social systems and create global risks.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves midday: Meta, Abercrombie & Fitch, Zoom, Intuit & more
item.description: These are some of the stocks posting the largest moves in midday trading.

item.title: States sue to block Trump-backed USPS mail-ballot rule after Supreme Court setback
item.description: The rule in question would require election officials to give USPS voter information and use federally reviewed, uniquely barcoded ballot envelopes.

item.title: SpaceX is 'attractively valued' after $100 billion Louisiana spaceport plan, Morgan Stanley says
item.description: Investors aren't appreciating the full scope of the rocket maker's plan to build a $100 billion spaceport in Louisiana.

item.title: S&P 500 is little changed after PCE report shows sticky inflation; Nvidia earnings on deck: Live updates
item.description: The S&P 500 moved slightly lower on Wednesday after the latest personal consumption expenditures price index reading revealed that inflation remains elevated.

item.title: Fed, NASA and DOJ among victims of Chinese state-sponsored hacker group: Court documents
item.description: Hackers targeted networks "operated by hospitals, telecommunications providers, power companies, financial institutions, and defense contractors," a filing said.

item.title: Lost in limbo: Where the Paramount merger delay leaves WBD, and what may come next
item.description: Paramount Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery is stalled due to an antitrust lawsuit, leaving WBD in limbo during a pivotal moment for media.

item.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge shows core prices rose 3.3% annually in July
item.description: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to rise 0.1% monthly and 3.6% on a 12-month basis, according to economists surveyed by Dow Jones.

item.title: Amazon service Bezos once called 'artificial artificial intelligence' is shutting down
item.description: Mechanical Turk launched in 2005 as a way to farm out tasks that are easy for humans to complete but too challenging for computers.

item.title: At least 98 killed and hundreds missing after flash floods in Nepal and China
item.description: At least 403 people, including 47 from the United States, were reported missing, officials in Nepal said.

item.title: Dollar and bond markets 'on edge' ahead of Jackson Hole as Bessent's market intervention piles pressure on Warsh
item.description: Strategists said investors were approaching Jackson Hole “on the back foot."

item.title: A breakout is brewing in this bitcoin-linked stock. How to trade it
item.description: Tony Zhang of OptionsPlay breaks down how he's trading this name.

item.title: Revolution Medicines gets FDA nod for targeted pancreatic cancer drug
item.description: The drug is a once-daily pill designed to block several forms of the RAS protein, which helps drive tumor growth in many pancreatic cancers.

item.title: Mark Walter's TWG Global blasts 'attacks,' insists 'no fraud' amid federal probe
item.description: The empire of billionaire Los Angeles Dodgers owner Mark Walter has faced media scrutiny since he said he would sell his majority share of the LA Lakers.

item.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño AI chip brings new 'threat' to Nvidia margins as custom silicon gains ground
item.description: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip beat Nvidia Blackwell systems on key inference-efficiency tests as custom AI silicon gains ground among major tech companies.

item.title: The post-penny economy: How cash rounding and credit card surcharges are changing what you pay
item.description: More merchants are rounding change for cash purchases to the nearest nickel due to the end of penny production, or adding surcharges to credit card transactions.

item.title: Iran says the U.S. is standing in the way of Hormuz deal amid talks with Oman
item.description: Iran and Oman are approaching a deal to secure safe transit through the Strait of Hormuz and future administration of the vital economic artery.

item.title: Medical device maker Boston Scientific is being hit by a cyberattack. The shares are falling
item.description: The attack has disrupted the company's ability to ship products, and it's not clear when services will be restored.

item.title: We're buying the dip — again — in a retailer not getting credit for addressing weak sales
item.description: Wednesday's decline can be attributed to a downgrade at Jefferies, which we disagree with.

item.title: New student loan rules are giving scammers a new opening. Here’s how to protect yourself
item.description: With student loan repayment changes underway, here’s how to spot the red flags and protect yourself.

item.title: Hyundai has grown more than any automaker in the U.S. — and it's not done yet
item.description: The South Korean automaker wants to keep going by ramping up production at a new $7.6 billion plant in Georgia to capture more sales and market share.

item.title: Here's why markets are starting to care about the 2026 election 10 weeks out
item.description: Wall Street analysts are tuning in 10 weeks ahead of the Nov. 3 election with concerns about risks to investors depending on how the U.S. results turn out.

item.title: Mortgage rates hit highest level in 3 weeks, weakening demand further
item.description: Mortgage rates rose again last week causing demand for both refinances and purchase loans to drop. Rates climbed to their highest level in three weeks.

item.title: Canada unveils retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of U.S. goods
item.description: Canadian trade negotiators left the U.S. last week after failing to clinch a trade deal that would stop President Donald Trump's new tariffs from taking effect.

item.title: I manage Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library in Cincinnati—the No. 1 lesson she taught me about success
item.description: Cincinnati literacy leader Kristy High reflects on Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library and the lesson Parton's philanthropy taught her about success.

item.title: SpaceX plans to build a $100 billion spaceport in Louisiana
item.description: SpaceX plans to establish its Starbase, LA in Vermilion Parish, which will "support thousands of launches annually."

item.title: Bond rout ending? Massive bets on bond rally dominate options market
item.description: There's an old Wall Street adage: Stocks float on a sea of bonds. Options traders are betting the tide is going out.

item.title: Sen. Darline Graham, Trump's pick for South Carolina Senate, wins GOP primary
item.description: Sen. Darline Graham on Tuesday defeated Rep. Ralph Norman, winning the GOP nomination for a South Carolina Senate seat.
